scripts.build: npm run build -w react-glaze && npm run build -w react-glaze-playground
scripts.dev: npm run build -w react-glaze && npm run dev -w react-glaze-playground
scripts.test: npm run build -w react-glaze && node --test packages/react/tests/*.test.mjs && npm run test:types -w react-glaze
scripts.dev:showcase: npm run build -w react-glaze && npm run dev -w showcase
scripts.build:showcase: npm run build -w react-glaze && npm run build -w showcase
scripts.check: npm test && npm run test:playground && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run build:showcase
